references.text: Refers to the water of purification (מֵי חַטָּאת) used for cleansing from impurity, the same expression as in Num 8:7
Describes how the water of purification is to be sprinkled on the unclean person to cleanse them, corresponding to the sprinkling of water on the Levites
The cleansing ritual for lepers includes shaving all hair and washing clothes, the same elements found in the Levites' cleansing
Washing of clothes (וְכִבְּסוּ בִגְדֵיהֶם) as part of the cleansing process
Aaron's cleansing and washing of his body with water before service in the sanctuary
Washing of Aaron and his sons with water as part of the consecration ritual for priestly service
God's promise to sprinkle clean water over Israel to cleanse them, using the same imagery of sprinkling for purification
Prayer for cleansing with hyssop, which was the instrument used to sprinkle the water of purification
Refers to cleansing rituals in the old covenant, including the sprinkling of water, which point forward to Christ's blood that cleanses the conscience
